package servermembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/fstest"

	server "example.com/servermembers/gen/http/members/server"
	"example.com/servermembers/gen/members"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMountedServerMemberIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	endpoints := &members.Endpoints{}
	fields := reflect.ValueOf(endpoints).Elem()
	for i := 0; i < fields.NumField(); i++ {
		name := members.MethodNames[i]
		fields.Field(i).Set(reflect.ValueOf(loom.Endpoint(func(_ context.Context, input any) (any, error) {
			return name + ":" + input.(string), nil
		})))
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	policy, err := loomhttp.NewRuntimeCORSPolicy(loomhttp.CORSPolicy{Origins: []loomhttp.CORSOrigin{{Pattern: "https://example.com", Methods: []string{"POST", "OPTIONS"}}}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	srv := server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil, policy,
		http.FS(fstest.MapFS{"Read": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("static-file")}}))
	srv.Use(func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			w.Header().Set("X-Wrapped", "yes")
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
	server.Mount(mux, srv)
	for _, name := range members.MethodNames {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/"+name, strings.NewReader(`"incoming"`))
			r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code, w.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, "yes", w.Header().Get("X-Wrapped"))
			var result string
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &result))
			require.Equal(t, name+":incoming", result)
		})
	}
	// Authored OPTIONS must select the renamed mount handler, not a neighbor.
	r := httptest.NewRequest("OPTIONS", "/mount", strings.NewReader(`"options"`))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.Header.Set("Origin", "https://example.com")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code, w.Body.String())
	require.Equal(t, "https://example.com", w.Header().Get("Access-Control-Allow-Origin"))
	require.Equal(t, "yes", w.Header().Get("X-Wrapped"))
	var result string
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &result))
	require.Equal(t, "mount:options", result)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/static", nil))
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code)
	require.Equal(t, "static-file", w.Body.String())
}
